quote: Scott is an amazing realtor, but he is also an amazing person outside of his vocation. He went above and beyond for my wife and me during one of the most stressful times of our lives. My wife was also pregnant and had a medical conference in Florida that we needed to attend. So, buying, selling, moving, baby, travel all occuring, what else could happen? Well, it did. Banks tried complicating the process and we weren't even in town to handle half of it. Scott did so much more than his job to help us with everything we had going on and my wife and I pray for his family and thank God for everything Scott did. I promise anyone that Scott is the person you want on your team and he is the only person I could fathom using or recommending. It will be the easiest and best decision you could make when going through a process that is so stressful. I consider him a friend now and his warm personality will certainly help you fell comfortable and confident with such an important decision.
